flows.title: First run
flows.description: A new user meets Agent Hub, registers their first agent and tests the connection before chatting.

flows.title: Start chatting
flows.description: From the catalog to a finished reply: pick an agent, start a session, watch it think, call tools and stream an answer.

flows.title: Agent produces work
flows.description: Research Analyst turns a request into a document artifact, then the user opens, edits, downloads and compares versions.

flows.title: Human in the loop
flows.description: Ledger pauses for approval before moving money, then runs a long background task and notifies the user when it's done.

flows.title: Attachments & voice
flows.description: The user shares a photo and a lab report with Health Assistant, gets an answer about them, then dictates a follow-up.

flows.title: Recovering from problems
flows.description: What the user sees when things go wrong: a failed reply, a dropped connection, rate limits, a session that's too long, and an agent going offline.

flows.title: Finding & organising
flows.description: Search everything with ⌘K, look up session details, share and export a session, delete with undo, and browse archives and artifacts.

flows.title: Switching agents
flows.description: Move between agents from anywhere. Switching always opens a fresh session; past sessions stay one click away in the sidebar.

flows.title: Settings & management
flows.description: Change preferences, wipe data safely, learn shortcuts, and manage an agent's details and health.

flows.title: Mobile
flows.description: The same product on a phone: browse agents, chat, open artifacts as full-screen sheets, reach past sessions from a drawer, and approve actions.

flows.title: Mobile core
flows.description: The v1 phone states: loading, starting and composing, streaming with tools, plans and questions, connection problems, switching agents, approval outcomes, and managing sessions with long-press and swipe.
